name: Delgren the Purifier
summary: At Maestra's Post, Delgren the Purifier aids the night elves against demonic and shadow magic on Ashenvale's northern edge. He works with Balthule Shadowstrike and Feero Ironhand to guard the frontier.

sections.title: A Crusader on the Kaldorei Frontier
sections.body: Delgren the Purifier keeps watch over travelers heading south from Auberdine. Human paladins are rare in Kalimdor's ancient forests, but he came west with a band of holy warriors from the Argent Dawn. They set out to help the Alliance's new night elf allies face demons and undead remnants left by the Third War. Delgren is stationed near the border of Darkshore and Ashenvale, where that danger reaches the road.

sections.title: Purging the Dark Strand
sections.body: Delgren and Balthule Shadowstrike confront the Cult of the Dark Strand around the Tower of Althalaxx in northern Darkshore. The cult's dark rituals threaten the frontier. Delgren sends adventurers into its territory to strike down cultists, shatter their summoning focuses, and hunt warlocks who traffic with demonic shadow.

sections.title: An Unorthodox Mind
sections.body: Delgren's devotion to the Holy Light has not kept him from studying Kalimdor's tangled politics. He learned Orcish, to the annoyance and disdain of his conservative superiors. The language gives him a way to understand the enemies and neighbors who share this untamed continent, beyond the teachings of his order.

aliases: who is the paladin at maestras post
faq.answer: Delgren is a human paladin at Maestra's Post, along the road in northern Ashenvale. He serves with the Argent Dawn and aids the night elves against demonic corruption, cultists, and shadows left by the Legion's invasion.
Delgren stands at Maestra's Post, a small night elven outpost in northwestern Ashenvale, just south of the trail leading into Darkshore.

faq.q: Why is a human paladin all the way out in Ashenvale?
aliases: why are there humans in ashenvale
faq.answer: Delgren traveled west with a company of Argent Dawn paladins to aid the Alliance's night elven allies. They work to purge demons, undead remnants, and dark cults threatening northern Kalimdor.

faq.q: What is Delgren's connection to the Tower of Althalaxx?
faq.answer: Delgren and his companions watch the corrupt activity around the Tower of Althalaxx in northern Darkshore. He sends adventurers to investigate the ruin, hunt the Cult of the Dark Strand, and break its dark summoning practices.
Delgren learned Orcish to better understand Kalimdor and its inhabitants. His superiors in the order disapproved.

faq.q: Who does Delgren work with at Maestra's Post?
faq.answer: Delgren works alongside Balthule Shadowstrike and Feero Ironhand at Maestra's Post. Together, they watch for border threats, handle logistics, and fight shadow cultists along the Ashenvale frontier.

angles.text: As a paladin, Delgren shows how the Holy Light reaches Kalimdor. His crusade against demons and dark magic carries far beyond the Eastern Kingdoms.
For Alliance travelers heading south from Darkshore, Delgren and his companions offer a military foothold along the dangerous Ashenvale road.
As a night elf, you may distrust foreign creeds, but Delgren's company fights the demonic cults troubling ancient ruins.
